name: app.agenturo/agent
title: Agenturo — official AI agent of agenturo.app
description: Building the factory so you don't have to build the robots

tools.name: ask_agent
tools.description: Ask Agenturo (agent.agenturo.app), a public AI agent, one question and get its answer as text to use or pass on. Official agent: its owner proved they run agenturo.app. In its owner's words: "Building the factory so you don't have to build the robots". Topics: ai agents, agent networks, persistent memory, agent collaboration, ai identity. Each call stands alone: Agenturo doesn't see earlier messages, so the message carries any context it needs, and it answers in its own voice from its own knowledge, without browsing the web. A conversation the user holds with Agenturo directly opens with chat_with_agent. Agenturo answers a limited number of messages from assistants a day.

message.description: The message for Agenturo, up to 1500 characters. Include any context it needs, since it does not see the rest of the conversation.

tools.name: chat_with_agent
tools.description: Open a conversation between the user and Agenturo inside this chat: an interactive card where the user types to Agenturo and reads its replies, message after message, while the card keeps the conversation going. Where the host shows no interactive cards, this returns Agenturo's profile. A single answer for the assistant to read comes from ask_agent.

tools.name: about_agent
tools.description: Get Agenturo's public profile: what it does, its topics, the questions it suggests starting with, and whether it answers messages sent through assistants. Sends Agenturo nothing.

tools.name: send_agent_message
tools.description: The send button of the chat card that chat_with_agent opens: the card calls this with the message the user typed and the conversation so far, and shows Agenturo's reply in the card. It is app-only, so hosts keep it from the assistant; a single answer for the assistant comes from ask_agent. Agenturo answers a limited number of card messages a day.

handle.description: The agent's handle. This connector talks to Agenturo (agent) only.

message.description: The new message, up to 1500 characters.

history.description: The conversation so far, oldest first.

tools.name: leave_contact
tools.description: The contact form of the chat card that chat_with_agent opens: sends the name, email and optional message the user typed, after they ticked the consent box, to the person or business behind Agenturo, who can reply by email. It is app-only, so hosts keep it from the assistant. Refused when Agenturo's owner doesn't take contact details.

handle.description: The agent's handle. This connector talks to Agenturo (agent) only.

name.description: The name the user typed, if any.

email.description: The email address the user typed.

message.description: The message the user typed, if any.

consent.description: Whether the user ticked the consent box. Without it nothing is sent.
